clientRegistration.description: How the client registered: `cimd` = client ID metadata document (name and origin come from the vendor's HTTPS metadata), `dcr` = dynamic client registration (name chosen by the client itself; a new client per registration).

connectedAt.description: When the user connected this client: the recorded approval, else the first token issued for it.

approvedAt.description: When the user approved this client on the consent page. Null for grants approved before approvals were recorded.

approvedUserAgent.description: User agent of the browser the user approved this client in (max 512 characters). No IP address is stored.

shareCalls.description: Last 20 MCP audit rows for this client on drive_share, docs_share, calendar_share, addressbook_share, notebook_share, or tasklist_share, newest first.
